paite: Huchi in bil a ka zak in, "Khopi kem mite michih hihmanna van tawi in hong nai uhen," chi in ngaihtak in akikou hi.
heading: Jerusalem Sawi In A-om

paite: Huan ngai in, mallam kongpi tungnung paina a kipan in mi guk ahong pai ua, michih in hihlupna van atawi chiat ua; alai ua mi khat puanmalngat silh in laituibuk akuah hi. Alut ua, dal maitam kiang ah adingh uhi.
Huan Israel' Pathian thupina a omna cherub a kipan in huai inn kongpi kiang ah apaitou a; puanmalngat silh, laituibuk kuahpa asam hi.
TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Khopi sung tawnsuak inla, Jerusalem tawnsuak in; asung a thilkihhuai hihsate ziak atunggik a kapte atal uah chiamteh in," achi hi.
Huan midangte kiang ah ka zak mahmah in, "Anung ah khopi tawnsuak unla, khut kha un, na mit un mumaih kei henla, hehpih sam kei un.
Putekte, tangvalte, nungakte, naupangte leh nute that siang vek un. Chiamtehna neite bel hon naih kei un; ka Mun Siangthou ah pan un," achi hi. Huchi in inn kong a upate ah apan uhi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Inn hihbuah unla, ahuangsungte mi luang in dimsak unla, pawt un," achi hi. Huan apawtta ua, khopi ah agamtangta uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, khopi ah agamtat lai un kei bel nutsiat in ka na om a, akhup in ka puk hi. "Ah! Toupa PATHIAN, Jerusalem tung a na hehna na sunbuak ah Israel khosuaksunte leng hihman vek sawm na hi hiam?" chi in ka kikou hi.

Huchi in ama'n ka kiang ah, "Israel leh Judah inkote thulimlouhna athupi tel a ahi. 'Sisan in gamsung adim a; khopi vaihawmna kaihkawi in a-om a, TOUPA'N gam apaisanta a, TOUPA'N bangmah amu kei!' achi hi.
Kei toh kisai in leng, ka mit in amau ka mumaih kei ding a, ka hehpih sam kei ding hi; agitlouhna uh avekpi in amau ka khusak ding," achi hi.
Huchi in ngai in, puanmalngat silh a laituibuk kuahpa'n thu atun a, "N'on thupiak bang in ka hih khinta," achi hi.
